text: Binary flag from the OP's `argument` column only: 1 if the OP's own assertions contain at least one hedging or qualifying expression that softens, limits or conditions a claim's strength or scope (e.g. 'might', 'perhaps', 'I think', 'to my knowledge', 'in some cases', 'generally'); 0 if the argument is assessable and has none. Ignore quoted text from others, quoted opponents' positions and moderator/bot notices unless the OP adopts them. Use the current text including marked edits, but exclude OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the view changed; generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Null if the argument is missing or malformed.
